assumptions.statement: The organizers have not supplied verifiable official polygons for the three scope levels or the three named key areas. Submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA geometries are rough provisional substitutes derived from public text and approximate areas under DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, diagrams and spatial relationships are provisional-only. With prominent provisional labeling they may support intake self-check, offline visualization, design discussion and review of proposal content, but they must not be scored as official boundaries, precise spatial evidence, statutory conclusions, approval or implementation bases.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace provisional scope and key-area polygons with organizer-issued, coordinate-system-verified geometry; rerun topology, clipping, areas, ratios, figures, HTML and PDFs as one versioned batch.

assumptions.statement: No verified site survey, georeferenced field photography, building inventory, structural condition, ground-floor use, tree-canopy/shade survey, pedestrian count, accessibility audit or maintenance record is present in the package.
assumptions.impact: Existing-condition, accessibility and performance statements remain hypotheses or design intentions. The submission must not claim surveyed compliance, existing-condition completeness or engineering feasibility.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Register fieldwork date, method, coverage, consent, collection rights and limitations; reconcile every surveyed feature and performance baseline before upgrading confidence.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, cadastral ownership, road redlines, heritage boundaries, ecological controls, municipal utilities, fire safety, daylight, underground space and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, demolition/retention, road and infrastructure proposals cannot be treated as statutory, approved or buildable conclusions. The constraints layer intentionally remains empty rather than fabricating official geometry.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain official or expressly cleared control documents and geometries, register their authority and reuse limits, and complete professional planning and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Operators, asset owners, delivery partners, budgets, procurement routes, staffing, maintenance capacity, pilot durations and binding service commitments have not been verified.
assumptions.impact: Programs, events, AI services, 24-hour support, financing and phased projects are proposals with entry/exit conditions, not commitments by government, owners or partners.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Confirm accountable entities, approvals, budget ranges, staffing, maintenance frequencies, pilot periods, success metrics, human takeover and stop actions in a project-level implementation table.

assumptions.statement: No verified cooperation agreements, operating interfaces or current datasets establish project-level links with Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area or the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.
assumptions.impact: Regional collaboration loops and external resource flows are conceptual network hypotheses only; named organizations must not be presented as committed partners.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Add current first-party sources and, where commitments are claimed, written confirmation from the responsible organization; distinguish background precedent from a local agreement.

assumptions.statement: Path-level rights evidence was reopened and manually reconciled on 2026-08-27 after the Phase 1 text, F08/F10/F11, HTML and PDF regeneration. The unresolved optional AI cover remains removed; authored text, structured data, unchanged concept geometry, generated figures, HTML and PDFs are recorded in report/copyright_statement.md, and redistributed Noto subsets carry their full OFL text and copyright notice.
assumptions.impact: The rights audit supports redistribution of this submission snapshot under its stated limits. It does not convert provisional data into official evidence or provide a legal non-infringement guarantee; any later asset change reopens the audit.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Any added or regenerated asset, font-source change, third-party media, or manifest hash change requires a new path-level rights reconciliation before publication.

assumptions.statement: Deterministic counterpart checks do not establish substantive equivalence, so a dated manual comparison was completed on 2026-08-27 for the 13-section order, one thesis, four primary messages, ten core claims, proper names, six-level wayfinding, metric status, source markers, SC/CX/IM/AP/U/C/TVS and F/T IDs, provisional-boundary limits, captions and on-figure positions.
assumptions.impact: The current bilingual snapshot is cleared for review as substantively aligned. This finding does not guarantee legal translation or future-file parity; any edit to paired text, figures, HTML or PDFs reopens the comparison.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete a dated human bilingual review covering proper names, claims, approximate indicators, source IDs, scenario limits, figure numbers and on-figure locations.

assumptions.statement: CX01–CX12 are stable candidate analysis paths clipped to the provisional site. Only CX02, CX05 and CX10 carry representative relationship-section design targets; none is a surveyed street section, accessibility audit, pedestrian count, road redline or engineering alignment.
assumptions.impact: Coordinates support repeatable comparison and fieldwork planning only. All existing widths, gradients, obstructions, crossings, user counts, ownership and maintenance duties remain unverified.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Register rights-cleared fieldwork with date, method, coverage, coordinates, consent, accessibility method and accountable reviewer; then replace candidate geometry and recalculate all dependent files.

assumptions.statement: Every Phase 2 dimension is tagged open-data-derived, design-target or unknown. Announced approximate key-area values are open-data-derived; 400 m comparison frames and representative-section bands are design targets; official extents, redlines and existing widths remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: No design target may be read as a measured fact or statutory control.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Any authoritative dimension or survey replaces only the matching field, then regenerates metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs.

assumptions.statement: The repository boundary-basis note records a 0% OSM heritage-park intersection and a 667 m average offset to four named OSM street centre-lines in a dated check. The raw OSM snapshot is not registered in the package.
assumptions.impact: These adverse results are retained as warnings. They neither invalidate nor validate the provisional polygon and cannot support survey, heritage-control, official-boundary or road-redline conclusions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Acquire an attributable, rights-cleared raw snapshot and/or authoritative geometry, register its hash and license, and rerun the comparison.
